exposure: Abnormal oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) at term
cohort: 1131 women at ≥37 weeks of gestation with normal glucose challenge test (GCT) who underwent a 100 g OGTT at term due to large for gestational age (LGA) fetus or polyhydramnios
finding: Abnormal OGTT at term was associated with a higher rate of cesarean deliveries, but no differences in other obstetric complications among women who delivered vaginally.
